response:
It's completely valid to trust your instincts about your own body. Symptoms like fatigue, hair loss, and weight changes can have many medical causes beyond depression, such as thyroid conditions or other physical health issues. It's important to bring these concerns to a healthcare professional who can properly evaluate you rather than relying on anyone's opinion, even someone close to you.

Regarding your husband's responses, whether or not it meets the definition of gaslighting, what matters is that you're feeling dismissed and unheard when you know something feels off in your body. You deserve to have your concerns taken seriously. Consider sharing with him how his reactions make you feel, and in the meantime, prioritize scheduling an appointment with your doctor to discuss all of your symptoms openly. You are your best advocate for your health.
